question: In a certain code language, 'WATCH' is written as '5B2D8'. How will 'HEAR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'WATCH' is written as '5B2D8',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c55ab0ed466d6654c5cf26a537f50c953a4bc72ff73193ae8362f1ab1e2ea9fb.png] 

Similarly, for 'HEAR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5466c753b29bccb2cbbf0a9cf475af0867274cace6763852da9a3ec3495bcae1.png] 

So, '**HEAR**' will be coded as '**8F1S**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
